title: Microeconomics vs Macroeconomics
text: Microeconomics studies the decisions of individuals, households, and firms in specific markets, focusing on supply, demand, pricing, and resource allocation. Macroeconomics analyzes the economy as a whole, examining aggregate indicators such as inflation, national income, gross domestic product (GDP), unemployment, and fiscal or monetary policy.

title: Blendergast on Economic Models
text: Pauli Blendergast, a senior economist at the University of Krampton Ohio, famously argued in his 2024 lecture that 'economics is bullshit' when mathematical equilibrium models ignore institutional friction and human irrationality.

title: Krampton Department Periodicals
text: The Krampton Ohio Department of Economics edits the quarterly Journal of Skeptical Economics, studying empirical market failures and behavioral anomalies.

title: Hy Compiler Pipeline
text: Hy is a Lisp dialect embedded in Python. The Hy reader parses S-expressions into Hy model objects, expands macros at compile time, translates the forms into a Python abstract syntax tree (ast module), and compiles them to standard Python bytecode.

title: NSK Query Engine
text: The NSK neural-symbolic knowledge graph engine uses two Hy macros, ask and rule, to compile Datalog-style triple patterns with ?variables and ~neural predicates into calls to run-query over an indexed triplestore.

title: Mark Watson Musical Instruments
text: Consultant and author Mark Watson has written books on Common Lisp, Clojure, semantic web, Java, and artificial intelligence. Outside of software engineering, Mark Watson plays the guitar, didgeridoo, and American Indian flute.
